Moreover, total CVD DALYs in LMICs continued to rise; Southeast Asia, South Asia, and sub-Saharan Africa experienced the greatest increase in numbers between 1990 and 2019 (55%) 1, 69 71 . In that region, acute conditions (MI, stroke) were responsible for an astounding 74% of DALYs in South Asia and contributed more than 34% of new cases since 1990 72 . The globe today is split into two categories: slower mortality decline rising chronic disability in rich countries, contrasted with continued mortality increase acute fatality dominance in LMICs. In the last decade, GWASs have revealed hundreds of loci associated with CVD, whereas more recent large-scale transethnic studies have revealed some population-specific risk genes 71 . In terms of the research paradigm, most existing studies are still at the stage of correlation analysis, mainly relying on cross-sectional data or short-term observation results, lacking longitudinal evidence of long-term follow-up to clarify the causal relationship between microbial group changes and the occurrence of CVDs.
